newsitem.title: USA: Ruby Tuesday sets growth targets, div plan.
newsitem.headline: Ruby Tuesday sets growth targets, div plan.

text.p: Ruby Tuesday Inc said on Monday that its five-year plan calls for earnings per share growth of 15-20 percent on revenue growth of 10 percent.
The plan also calls for pre-tax margin of seven percent and return-on-equity of 20 percent.
The company said growth is to be achieved by adding new units at a 10 percent rate in company-owned restaurants and from the its domestic franchise partner program designed to add new units.
Ruby Tuesday said its board has authorized the additional repurchase of up to one million shares, bringing the total shares available for repurchase to approximately two million.

The board has also approved a dividend policy that calls for payment of semi-annual dividends of about $3 million annually, with the first dividend expected to be paid in the third quarter of fiscal 1998.
Ruby Tuesday said its financial strategy includes a recommitment to a targeted debt-to-capital ratio not to exceed 60 percent, including operating leases.
